record.label: One femtosecond of evolution with full-output error at most 0.01
record.statement: A candidate circuit must realize a single unitary $W$ whose action on every system state with zero ancillas is within $\varepsilon=10^{-2}$ of $e^{-iHt}$ with zero ancillas, for $t=1$ fs and up to a global phase.
record.boundary: The identity system projector includes superpositions of all basis states. On the output, the norm includes any component with nonzero ancillas, since the ideal output has all 417 ancillas in zero. The same phase works for all inputs.
